cohort: Parous women from the National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey data from 2005 to 2012
finding: Older age at first delivery was associated with a higher risk of subsequent pelvic organ prolapse, particularly among women with at least one vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: The association between age at first delivery and prolapse risk was significant for women with at least one vaginal delivery but not for those with only cesarean deliveries.
